arguments.message: Supervise exec command groups and classify post-start failures
arguments.title: Fix exec lifecycle accounting and descendant cleanup (#50)
arguments.body:
Closes #50.

Before changing code, `TestExec_InheritedPipeWaitFailureIsNotStartFailure` reproduced the bug: a shell exited 0 while a descendant held its pipe open, and the tool reported `process_start_failed: exec: WaitDelay expired before I/O complete` with no effect. The tool now distinguishes actual start/process state from wait failures, reports unknown effects for post-start capture failures, marks incomplete output, and signals its process group on cancellation/timeout (TERM then KILL after 200ms) or after an inherited-pipe failure. It reaps the leader; it does not sandbox or promise to contain deliberately detached descendants. Explicit timeouts over two minutes remain usable. The human `!` shell's lifecycle is unchanged except for sharing the status helper's new ProcessState argument. v0 §9/§14 now describe only the implemented scope.

Offline verification on macOS: `gofmt -l` (empty), `git diff --check`, `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...` (cmd: no tests; internal/reagent: ok, 16.547s). Focused cancellation/timeout/inherited-pipe regressions passed 3 runs. `GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...` passed; Linux runtime tests were not run. No live model run or API spend. `exec` still cannot supervise processes that leave its group; bounded disk log artifacts can already be made with shell redirection and read with read_file, so no new log API was added.

arguments.message: Handle nonzero exits with surviving exec descendants
arguments.body: Addressed the nonzero-exit held-pipe gap. Reproduced it first: `(sleep 2; touch late) & exit 3` returned `command_failed` / `effect: applied` with unmarked output and the child survived. After `Run`, a nonzero leader now probes its process group; surviving members are killed and the result is `descendant_unresolved` / unknown with the leader's exit code retained. `output_may_be_incomplete` is separate from stdout/stderr `truncated` (those still mean bytes trimmed by the result budget); the clean-exit redirected-background case remains ordinary. Added tests for all three cases and updated v0 §9. Checks on macOS passed: gofmt (empty), `git diff --check`, `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...` (internal/reagent 18.677s), `go test -race ./...` (32.149s), focused cases `-count=3`, and Linux amd64 cross-build. Linux runtime tests and live model trials were not run.
